description: Licitații Medicale publishes corrected public-hospital procurement tables for Romania covering 2018–2026. Version 2 contains 291 hazardous-medical-waste procedures and 16,072 medical-device procedures, excluding pharmaceuticals from the latter. Each row identifies a procedure, hospital, winners, published values, framework status, award date, duration and its source. Separate tables document grouping, exclusions and twelve-month expiry windows. The workflow combines TED notices with SICAP records distributed through OpenTender/OCDS. Files are public CSVs with Romanian methodology notes, available free under CC BY 4.0 and archived in two Zenodo releases. A limitation is that published award or maximum framework values are not actual spending. SICAP coverage is limited to 2020–2024; later observations rely on TED above its reporting threshold, and missing durations can use an explicitly flagged estimate. Version 1 was withdrawn after systematic duplicate-counting and scope errors; the draft points to current version 2. Simulation uses include modelling hospital supply relationships, waste-service dependencies and procurement renewal scenarios. It relates to data-hifld-open as a complementary example of hospital inventories; this procurement collection instead describes hospital suppliers and contracts. No contract rows, audit results or financial totals were independently recomputed.
